articles.title: Democrats Target Trump’s $100 Billion Venezuela Oil Deal
articles.description: Congressional Democrats are preparing multiple investigations into President Donald Trump's $100 billion Venezuela oil agreement, with plans to subpoena administration officials over a deal that handed a little-known private company rights to 17 Venezuelan oilfields. The August agreement gives Alejandro Betancourt's North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) 100-year concessions covering fields with an estimated 65 billion barrels of reserves. Washington receives a 35% equity stake in the company and the right to purchase 20% of its oil production…

articles.title: Reliance Bets $1.6 Billion on India's Biogas Boom
articles.description: India’s biggest conglomerate and top private refiner, Reliance Industries, plans to invest $1.6 billion in 100 biogas plants in the country by the end of the decade, Vikas Rathi, CFO at Reliance Bio Energy Limited, said on Tuesday. Reliance Industries, chaired by Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani, operates the world’s largest refining complex at Jamnagar. articles.description: Oil prices slipped on Tuesday, 17 November, with forecasts of a global supply surplus outweighing ongoing security concerns in the Middle East, reported Reuters.

articles.title: U.S. Opens New Front in Campaign to Cut Off Iran’s Supply Routes
articles.description: The US military is expanding its efforts to disrupt Iran's supply networks beyond the naval blockade of its ports, turning its attention to the country's land borders and the Caspian Sea. articles.title: TTF Gas Bounces Back to 86 Euros as Hormuz Risks Resurface
articles.description: Following a 7% dip on Monday, European benchmark natural gas prices rebounded on Tuesday morning in Amsterdam amid continued attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran targeting U.S. bases in Bahrain, and forecasts of a cold spell in large parts of Europe beginning later this week. The front-month price at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF), the benchmark for Europe’s gas trading, rose by 2% as of 8:00 a.m. in Amsterdam on Tuesday, to $94.61 (86 euros) per megawatt-hour (MWh). articles.title: Malaysia Signs First Critical Minerals Pact With France
articles.description: Malaysia signed on Tuesday its first pact on critical minerals with a European country as France pledged to help the Asian economy develop an integrated high-value critical minerals supply chain. articles.title: UK Pushes for Global Levies on Polluting Industries
articles.description: The UK is leading a drive to have countries consider small levies on polluting industries globally to raise funding for climate initiatives in developing countries, which are the worst affected by climate change. The UK plans to continue pushing for a conversation about levies on polluting sectors into 2027, when it will be the president of the G-20 group of nations. This week, a declaration at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya is expected to acknowledge the idea of “small levies” to raise climate funding, Bloomberg News reported…
